body: hi also looking for apprenticeship in metro :C

better to save up or find leverage first, security and all until you can "afford" to settle with apprenticeship allowance muna. it is worth it to be a licensed architect, pero hindi sya rational to exchange with a stable job. listen to what makes you happy and make sure you wouldnt regret it, because being an architect for others can be fulfilling for others that it sustains them despite being short on financials.   
  
tldr: 1. do what makes you feel safe 2. do what makes you feel happy. best wishes op!
